plan.output: A side-by-side report highlighting statements in a later agent answer that are not clearly supported by the prior answer.
inputs: Two fictional consecutive agent answers on the same task
A short operator-supplied checklist of claims that must remain intact
plan.trigger: An operator pastes a pair of consecutive answers for review.
steps: Split each answer into short factual statements.
Compare later statements with the earlier answer and the supplied checklist.
Mark additions, contradictions, and uncertain paraphrases separately.
Show each marked statement beside both source answers.
Ask a person to decide whether each mark is a real drift issue.
plan.acceptanceCheck: On fictional answer pairs with deliberately added, changed, and preserved statements, check whether the report points to the exact later text and retains both comparison passages.
plan.humanBoundary: The operator supplies safe text and the checklist; a person determines truth and decides whether a difference matters. Do not send private work text to an unapproved service.
